name: slide-metadata
body:
Every slide's layout and sections receive derived, render-time slide metadata under the reserved `slide` context: `{{.slide.number}}` — the slide's position label, a STRING formed from its `(number, letter)` position (slide-position / positionKey): the number, with the lower-cased letter appended when the slide is a vertical (letter) slide and omitted when it is horizontal (e.g. `1-intro.md` → `"1"`, `1a-detail.md` → `"1a"`) — and `{{.slide.total}}` — the total number of slide files in the deck, an integer. This metadata is computed at render time from the deck model; it is NOT authored frontmatter, is never read from a slide's YAML, and is distinct from the slide's fields. `.slide.number` is neither a flattened presentation index nor the bare filename integer: a vertical slide's label includes its letter.
AC: in a deck of slide files 1-intro.md, 1a-detail.md, 2-agenda.md, 5-close.md, `.slide.number` is the string `"1"` for the horizontal slide, `"1a"` for its vertical child, `"2"`, and `"5"`, and `.slide.total` is the integer 4; a gap in the filename numbering does not change either value.
